claim: Body/FAQ: AccessLink moves Polar Flow data; Team Pro moves Team Pro data; terms apply to both.

claim: Body: Polar mobile SDK reads live data.

claim: Body/FAQ: dynamic rate limit scales with registered users.
quote: Dynamic rate limit scales partners rate limit values based on number of registered users. Rate limit values are updated daily.

claim: Body/FAQ: 15-minute formula.

claim: Body/FAQ: 24-hour formula.

claim: Body/FAQ: 429 and short-term violations count toward long-term.
